title: Give the Entra Policy Suite update identity a missing permission, or take one away
purpose: Grants the update identity (id-eps-updater) the Microsoft Graph application permissions Entra Policy Suite declares for it, when one is missing after the install - or takes one away with -Remove. Only the declared permissions can be asked for. Every change is read back.
whenToRun: When the update run says one of its rights is missing (the install ran as an account that could not grant it, or a release declares a new one). The update job never grants itself a right.

runAs.name: Privileged Role Administrator (or Global Administrator)
runAs.why: grants application permissions to a managed identity

runAs.name: Reader
runAs.scope: the Entra Policy Suite resource group

changes.object: app role assignments on the update identity
changes.permission: the Graph permissions asked for (from the declared list)
changes.why: the update job keeps the database setup identity in the SQL admin group (PIM for Groups), reads that membership back, and keeps the web app's sign-in registration it owns as it should be
changes.undo: run again with -Remove and the same permissions

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: the install's resource group (an install made before 2.0.55: rg-entrapolicysuite, found by itself when it is there)

parameters.name: GraphPermission
parameters.help: the Graph permissions to grant or remove; none given: every Graph permission the update identity needs

parameters.name: Remove
parameters.help: take the named rights away instead (it never removes everything at once)

readsOnly: Azure: the update identity's object id
Graph: the update identity's app role assignments
whatIf: What the update identity has, and what would be granted or removed; nothing is changed.
undo: Run again with -Remove (or without it, to grant back).
